parameters.name: Xserver
parameters.help: 'This Screen' for current display or type in a display name to OVERRIDE the current display default.

parameters.name: NEWTABLE
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a velocity file from the menu.

parameters.name: PRECOMP
parameters.help: Incoming data has been precomputed using the vaprecom tool.

parameters.name: RMO
parameters.help: Configure parameters for residual velocity analysis

parameters.name: SETPARMS
parameters.prompt: Set the values for the computation variables?
parameters.help: Change all of the necessary parameters when running in interactive mode.

parameters.name: NSMASH
parameters.prompt: Number of CDPs to sum into gather
parameters.help: Enter the number of CDPs to use to build the commom offset stacked supergather.

parameters.name: SMASHNMO
parameters.help: Apply partial NMO before summing trace to offset bin center for supergather.

parameters.name: SMASHSTA
parameters.help: Apply differential CDP mean statics prior to offset  super gather stack generation.

parameters.name: INITDIST
parameters.prompt: Absolute offset of first bin center
parameters.help: Enter the center of the first offset bin.

parameters.name: BINSIZE
parameters.prompt: Bin size for vertically summing offsets
parameters.help: Enter the offset bin size for summing offsets for supergather generation.

parameters.name: MAXOFFS
parameters.help: Enter the maximum offset for creating common offset stacked supergather.

parameters.name: USEAOFF
parameters.prompt: Use absolute value of offset for stacking?
parameters.help: If YES absolute value of offset is used to stack gathers for 2D data.  Otherwise, signed offset is used.  3D always uses absolute offset.

parameters.name: MINVEL
parameters.help: Minimum expected stacking value - value of first semblance scan.

parameters.name: MAXVEL
parameters.help: Maximum expected stacking value - value of last semblance scan.

parameters.name: NVELS
parameters.help: Number of semblance scans to perform between the minimum and maximum velocity range.

parameters.name: VELSPACE
parameters.help: Method of spacing velocities along semblance axis.

choices.label: Equal Velocity
choices.help: Semblance velocity spacing and display is logrithmic between minimum and maximum velocity.

choices.label: Slowness Squared
choices.help: Spacing proportional to slowness squared. Use this option ONLY to create semblances for Velocity Auto Picker.

parameters.name: WINSIZE
parameters.help: Enter the semblance sample rate in milliseconds - distance between analysis window centers.

parameters.name: RSMOOTH
parameters.help: Enter size of window over which semblance will be calculated.

parameters.name: NVFS
parameters.help: Number of velocity functions and the number of stack strips.

parameters.name: NSTACK
parameters.prompt: Number of CDPS per stack strip
parameters.help: Number of CDPS to stack for each of the velocity function stacks.

parameters.name: NORMSTK
parameters.prompt: Scale stacks by number of live samples summed
parameters.help: Divide function velocity stacks, dynamic stacks, and flip stacks by number of live samples summed into stacks.

parameters.name: VFSTYPE
parameters.help: Method of computing velocity function from guide velocity function.

parameters.name: VFDELTA
parameters.help: Change in moveout (delta t) between the velocity functions at the farthest offset.

parameters.name: VFCENT
parameters.help: Maximum percent change of the fan relative to the guide function (minimum and maximum).

parameters.name: VFMINVEL
parameters.help: The fan at time 0 will be the this value (in units/sec) wide centered at the guide function velocity

parameters.name: VFMAXVEL
parameters.help: The fan at maximum time will be the this value (in units/sec) wide centered at the guide function velocity

parameters.name: VIEWFLAG
parameters.help: Set on/off the various panels and displays in Velocity Analysis.

parameters.name: SHOWSEMB
parameters.help: Display the semblance plot.

parameters.name: SHOWVF
parameters.help: Display the velocity functions on the semblance panel.

parameters.name: SHOWCONT
parameters.help: Display the semblance contours on the semblance panel.

parameters.name: SHOWINT
parameters.help: Display the interval velocity function on the semblance panel as the stacking velocity function is picked.

parameters.name: SHOWGUID
parameters.help: Display the guide function.

parameters.name: SHOWGAT
parameters.help: Display the smashed super gather.

parameters.name: PLOTTYPE
parameters.help: Plot seismic data in the form of wiggly lines or grayscale.

choices.label: WIGGLES
choices.help: Plot seimsic data as wiggly lines

choices.label: GRAYSCALE
choices.help: Plot seimsic data as grayscale density

parameters.name: APPLYNMO
parameters.help: Normal moveout correct the gather panel according to the current pick velocity function

parameters.name: ANIMNMO
parameters.help: Normal moveout correct a slice of the gather panel according to the velocity coordinate of the dragged mouse location

parameters.name: SHOWDYN
parameters.help: Display a stack that represents the stack with the current picked velocity function.

parameters.name: SHOWFLIP
parameters.help: Display the flip stacks - (the function stacks displayed as a movie).

parameters.name: SHOWSTK
parameters.help: Display the velocity function stacks.

parameters.name: SHOWVEL
parameters.help: Display the velocity color background under the function stacks and dynamic stack.

parameters.name: SHOWKEY
parameters.help: Display the velocity color key beneath the semblance panel.

parameters.name: SHOWGHOR
parameters.help: Select YES to display previously picked horizon(s) in the gather.

parameters.name: SHOWVHOR
parameters.prompt: Show horizons on velocity function stacks panel?
parameters.help: Select YES to display previously picked horizon(s) in the velocity function stacks.

parameters.name: SHOWDHOR
parameters.prompt: Show horizons on dynamic stack panel?
parameters.help: Select YES to display previously picked horizon(s) in the dynamic stack.

parameters.name: SHOWFHOR
parameters.prompt: Show horizons on flip stacks panel?
parameters.help: Select YES to display previously picked horizon(s) in the flip stacks.

parameters.name: SHOWPRES
parameters.help: Select YES to display current CDP guide function on Semblance and Function Velocity Stacks

parameters.name: SHOWAVE
parameters.help: Select YES to display average-of-all-CDPs guide function on Semblance and Function Velocity Stacks

parameters.name: SHOWPREV
parameters.help: Select YES to display previous CDP guide function on Semblance and Function Velocity Stacks

parameters.name: SHOWNEXT
parameters.help: Select YES to display next CDP guide function on Semblance and Function Velocity Stacks

parameters.name: SHOWLAST
parameters.help: Select YES to display last-viewed CDP guide function on Semblance and Function Velocity Stacks

parameters.name: TRACEWID
parameters.help: Equalize the displayed trace width in the gather and stack panels.

parameters.name: SEMBWID
parameters.help: Relative width of semblance panel compared to other panels.

parameters.name: GATWID
parameters.help: Relative width of gather panel compared to other panels. Zero selects trace equalization default.

parameters.name: DYNWID
parameters.prompt: Relative width of dynamic stack panel
parameters.help: Relative width of dynamic stack panel compared to other panels. Zero selects trace equalization default.

parameters.name: FLIPWID
parameters.prompt: Relative width of flip stacks panel
parameters.help: Relative width of flip stacks panel compared to other panels. Zero selects trace equalization default.

parameters.name: VFWID
parameters.prompt: Relative width of velocity function stack panel
parameters.help: Relative width of velocity function stack panel compared to other panels. Zero selects trace equalization default.

parameters.name: SEMBPARM
parameters.prompt: Set semblance scaling and autosnap parameters?
parameters.help: Configure scaling and autosnap parameters for the semblance display

parameters.name: NORM
parameters.help: Choose method of normalizing semblances.

parameters.name: RPOWER
parameters.help: Raise each semblance sample power to this power before plotting.  A value greater/less than 1.0 increases/decreases the contrast.

parameters.name: RNOISE
parameters.help: Add this value to maximum semblance before scaling (not used if no scaling applied).  Recommend 0.0 to 0.4

parameters.name: AUTOSNAP
parameters.help: Options to automatically snap velocity function for new ensemble.

parameters.name: HOR_DIST
parameters.help: Horizontal search distance (in percent) for the neighboring highest semblance.

parameters.name: VER_DIST
parameters.help: Vertical search distance (in msec) for the neighboring highest semblance.

parameters.name: MUTEMODE
parameters.help: Use top and/or base mutes picked on the Gather panel and/or a mute file.

choices.label: TOP
choices.help: Mute from top mute upward and make top mute editable.

choices.label: BASE
choices.help: Mute from base mute downward and make base mute editable.

choices.label: BOTH
choices.help: Mute from top mute upward and base mute downward. Top mute initially editable.

parameters.name: TOPMUTE
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a mute table from the menu.

parameters.name: BASEMUTE
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a mute table from the menu.

parameters.name: MUTETAPE
parameters.help: Taper length of end of mute in vertical units.

parameters.name: SHOWHOR
parameters.help: Methods to select horizon display and color.

choices.label: NONE
choices.help: Don't show any horizons, but remember selections.

choices.label: POP-MENU
choices.help: Select using a pop-up menu. Faster, but no color.

choices.label: EXPLICIT
choices.help: Select each horizon and color explicitly.

parameters.name: HORDATUM
parameters.prompt: To which datum are the horizons referenced?
parameters.help: Velocity Analysis will shift horizons picked at final datum to floating datum so that horizons picked on conventional stacks can be used for analysis.

choices.label: Final Datum
choices.help: Horizons were picked from a stack referenced to final datum (F_DATUM).

choices.label: Floating Datum
choices.help: Horizons were picked from a stack referenced to floating datum (N_DATUM)

parameters.name: PD_OPT
parameters.prompt: Interact with other processes using PD?
parameters.help: If set to yes, a PD connection will be initiated to communicate with VVE and/or the 3D Viewer

parameters.name: GUIDTYPE
parameters.help: Guide file type.

parameters.name: GUIDEOPT
parameters.prompt: Get guide function from an existing parameter table?
parameters.help: Get the guide function from the list of RMS velocity parameter tables

parameters.name: GUIDETBL
parameters.help: Guide function for fan function stacks, and picking. Use Mouse Button 1 to select a velocity file from the menu.

parameters.name: MINGDVEL
parameters.help: Semblance analysis value at minimum time/depth to use as guide.

parameters.name: MAXGDVEL
parameters.help: Semblance analysis value at maximum time/depth to use as guide.

parameters.name: STRETCH
parameters.help: Any trace stretched more than this factor will be excluded from the semblance analysis. Enter 0.0 to turn off this option

parameters.name: LONGOFFS
parameters.help: Choose desired method for long-offset moveout correction.

choices.label: NONE
choices.help: Apply only two term NMO (normal application).

choices.label: CASTLE
choices.help: Apply Castle's shifted hyperbola (slow, least accurate).

choices.label: HARLAN
choices.help: Apply Harlan's anisotropic third term (slower, good accuracy).

choices.label: TSVANKIN
choices.help: Apply Tsvankin and Thomsen's third term (slowest, most accurate).

parameters.name: ETA
parameters.help: Value of zero means no anisotropy correction. Normally nonnegative and less than 0.1

parameters.name: LASTINT
parameters.help: Constant interval velocity used to phantom in unpicked velocity at time max. Use a a value of 0.0 to turn this option off

parameters.name: PICKTYPE
parameters.help: Pick file type

parameters.name: COPYPICK
parameters.help: Select YES to copy the picks at one location to the next location if no function previously exists.

parameters.name: DEBUG
parameters.help: To debug program, enter YES.

parameters.name: program
parameters.help: Type path name of program executable.
